title: YouCoded name and icon ideas, round 4

steps.path: Website header, app, everywhere the name is written
steps.headline: More chunky and gradient name styles, several with the mascot as the 'o'. Which do you like?
steps.notice: Built from your round-3 picks: W6 (chunky), W11 (gradient) and L3 (mascot as the 'o'). Shown in today's header, then in three other themes along the bottom.

variants.label: N1 Chunky gradient
variants.summary: W6 and W11 together: the chunky rounded lowercase from W6, filled with the theme-colour-to-pink fade from W11.

variants.label: N2 Chunky + mascot "o"
variants.summary: The W6 lowercase with the mascot standing in for the first "o", sized to the letters, feet hanging below the line.

variants.label: N3 Gradient + mascot "o"
variants.summary: The same mascot "o", with every letter in the colour fade, so the mascot pops out as the only solid shape.

variants.label: N4 Glossy, like the mascot
variants.summary: Rounded Fredoka letters with the mascot as the "o" and a shiny top highlight that matches the shine on the app icon's mascot.

variants.label: N5 Toy-block 3D
variants.summary: Fat Lilita One letters with a deep 3D edge underneath, like a plastic toy or a game logo.

variants.label: N6 Sticker edge
variants.summary: Chunky lowercase with a thick white sticker border and soft shadow, so it pops on any wallpaper.

variants.label: N7 Wallpaper inside the letters
variants.summary: The letters are cut out of your theme's own wallpaper, so the name literally wears your theme.

variants.label: N8 Bouncy
variants.summary: Grandstander letters that hop slightly up and down, playful like the mascot waving.

variants.label: N9 Clean + mascot "o"
variants.summary: The closest to today's site: Nunito capitals, colour fade on "You", mascot as the "o". The grown-up version.

variants.label: N10 Soft two-tone
variants.summary: Sniglet: the roundest, softest letters, "you" in the theme colour with a gentle shine, "coded" in the text colour.

variants.label: N11 Cartoon
variants.summary: Chewy, a hand-drawn cartoon font, in the colour fade: the most playful option.

variants.label: N12 Two mascots
variants.summary: Both "o"s are mascots, one in "you" and one in "coded". Fun, but busier and harder to read small.

steps.path: Taskbar, Mac Dock, browser tab, next to the clock
steps.headline: Which app icon ideas do you like?
steps.notice: Each card shows one idea everywhere it would appear: Windows taskbar, Mac Dock, its own browser-tab version, and a one-colour version for next to the clock. I1–I6 are led by the mascot's character; J1–J6 by the name and personality.

variants.label: I1 The head is the icon
variants.summary: The whole icon is the mascot's face — its square head is already the shape of an app icon — with a little arm waving off the corner.

variants.label: I2 Window to your world
variants.summary: The icon is a window onto your theme's world; the mascot leans out over the sill to say hi, and the view changes with your theme.

variants.label: I3 Peekaboo
variants.summary: The mascot is hiding behind the icon, peeking over the top with both hands gripping the edge — playful and still clear when tiny.

variants.label: I4 On a cloud
variants.summary: The mascot stands waving on a soft cloud in the Cotton Candy dawn colours — the website's sky turned into a little scene.

variants.label: I5 Night glow
variants.summary: Late at night, the mascot is lit up by the little screen in its hands — warm, cosy, and it pops on a dark taskbar.

variants.label: I6 Hooray
variants.summary: The mascot jumps with both arms up — the "done it!" moment — and its arms-up shape doubles as a Y for YouCoded.

variants.label: J1 The "o"
variants.summary: The mascot drawn as a chunky white letter "o" with eyes, arms and feet, so the icon is both a letter of our name and our character.

variants.label: J2 Chunky "y"
variants.summary: A big glossy purple-to-pink "y" (the name's chunky lettering) with the mascot sitting in its fork, waving.

variants.label: J3 Die-cut sticker
variants.summary: The waving mascot as a thick white sticker stuck on at an angle, with one corner peeling up.

variants.label: J4 Pressed to the glass
variants.summary: The website's frosted glass with the mascot pressed right up against it: its body blurred, its face sharp.

variants.label: J5 Speech bubble
variants.summary: The mascot's head is a chat bubble and its arm swings down to become the bubble's tail, mouth open mid-hello.

variants.label: J6 Clean silhouette
variants.summary: A simple white cut-out of the waving mascot on the purple-to-pink gradient: the boldest at small sizes.
